title: Case Deflection Companion

title: Apex Test Generator

description: Ranks inbound leads against your closed-won history and explains each score in plain language for reps.

description: Reads inbound invoice emails, matches them to purchase orders, and flags mismatches for finance review.

title: Order Status Concierge
description: Answers where-is-my-order questions by joining commerce order data with carrier tracking updates.

title: Onboarding Checklist Bot
description: Guides new hires through IT provisioning and HR tasks, opening tickets automatically as each step completes.

title: Pipeline Health Analyst
description: Summarizes stalled opportunities each morning and recommends the next best action per deal.

title: Knowledge Article Drafter
description: Converts resolved support cases into first-draft knowledge articles for an agent to review and publish.

title: Expense Policy Checker
description: Reviews submitted expenses against company policy and explains any exceptions before manager approval.

title: Inventory Reorder Advisor
description: Watches stock levels across ERP records and drafts reorder requests before popular SKUs run out.

title: Meeting Notes Synthesizer
description: Joins a call, captures action items, and syncs follow-ups to the right records without manual entry.

title: Quote Approval Router
description: Routes discount requests to the right approver based on margin thresholds and logs the decision trail.

title: Churn Signal Detector
description: Flags at-risk customers from support and usage trends, then drafts a save-play for the account owner.
